sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你制作了这档终极《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We are very excited about our new podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们对我们的新播客感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: But we wanted to give you a little sneak peek.
sentences.zh: 但我们想先让你一睹为快。

sentences.en: Each week, we'll break down a new episode of The Office.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会解析一集新的《办公室》。

sentences.en: We're starting at the beginning and going in order.
sentences.zh: 我们将从第一集开始，按顺序进行。

sentences.en: So you can watch along with us.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以和我们一起重温。

sentences.en: In each episode, we will give you what I like to call fast facts.
sentences.zh: 在每一集中，我会分享我称之为“快速事实”的内容。

sentences.en: You do like to call them that.
sentences.zh: 你确实喜欢这么叫它们。

sentences.en: So you'll get three fast facts.
sentences.zh: 所以你每集会听到三个快速事实。

sentences.en: And then after the fast facts, we will go through the episode.
sentences.zh: 在快速事实之后，我们会详细回顾那一集的内容。

sentences.en: And we're going to tell you behind-the-scenes stories.
sentences.zh: 我们会告诉你幕后的故事。

sentences.en: So do you remember Booze Cruise?
sentences.zh: 你还记得《游轮派对》那一集吗？

sentences.en: So here's the deal about Booze Cruise, you guys.
sentences.zh: 关于《游轮派对》，情况是这样的，各位。
我们平时从不进行夜间拍摄。

sentences.en: We would show up for Booze Cruise.
sentences.zh: 我们当时得去拍《游轮派对》。

sentences.en: We had to go to a boat in Long Beach.
sentences.zh: 我们得去长滩的一艘船上。

sentences.en: We had to get there at like 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我们大概下午4点就得赶到那里。

sentences.en: And we filmed till like 5 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 然后一直拍到凌晨5点左右。

sentences.en: Well, one of the fun things was that we all got hotel rooMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中一件有趣的事是，我们都分到了酒店房间。

sentences.en: So it was like a big slumber party.
sentences.zh: 所以那感觉就像一场大型睡衣派对。

sentences.en: Jenna, I have been wanting to ask you this question.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我一直想问你这个问题。

sentences.en: I don't know why I've never asked you this question.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我从来没问过你。

sentences.en: But did you have to do the puking scene?
sentences.zh: 你当时需要拍呕吐的那场戏吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I didn't have to do it.
A lot of you guys did though, right?
sentences.zh: 但你们很多人都做了，对吧？

sentences.en: Greg Daniels thought it'd be really funny if a bunch of people in the episode got seasick.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·丹尼尔斯觉得如果剧里有一群人晕船会很有趣。

sentences.en: Well, a lot of people in real life got seasick.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现实中很多人确实晕船了。

sentences.en: Oh, in real life, people were like turning green.
sentences.zh: 哦，现实中，大家脸色都变绿了。

sentences.en: Yacking off the side of that boat.
It had this like subtle like roll back and forth.
sentences.zh: 船身有一种细微的晃动。

sentences.en: And people got like, they got like really sick.
And everyone had those bracelets with the little...
sentences.zh: 每个人都戴着那种手环，上面有个小……

sentences.en: But we didn't have success with them.
Anyway, so here we are shooting all night long.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们当时整晚都在拍摄。

sentences.en: And Greg comes up to me.

sentences.zh: 格雷格·丹尼尔斯，我们的剧集主管，创作者。

sentences.en: And he's like, hey, Angela, will you do some of the puking stuff?
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，安吉拉，你能演一些呕吐的戏份吗？

sentences.en: Kate Flannery is going to do it.
He was just grabbing random people to get puking shots.
sentences.zh: 他只是随手抓人来拍呕吐的镜头。

sentences.en: In between scenes, he would take the B camera operator and we would go out on the back of
sentences.zh: 在场景切换的间隙，他会带着B机摄影师，我们一起走到船尾。

sentences.en: You could take a big swig of cold minestrone soup.
sentences.zh: 你可以喝一大口冷掉的蔬菜汤。
或者是冷的奶油蘑菇汤。

sentences.en: That's what I would have picked.
sentences.zh: 如果是我，我也会选那个。

sentences.en: And they said, okay, take a huge swallow and hold it in your mouth until we say action.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好了，喝一大口含在嘴里，直到我们喊开始。

sentences.en: And on action, spew it out.
sentences.zh: 喊开始的时候，就吐出来。

sentences.en: And I want you to know the 10 seconds it took them to get the camera ready, holding that cold
sentences.zh: 我想让你们知道，在他们准备摄像机的这十秒钟里，嘴里含着那口冷汤，

sentences.en: I literally started to physically gag, like, and then on action, they were like, spew.
sentences.zh: 我真的开始生理性干呕了，然后一喊开始，他们就说，吐。

sentences.en: And then none of it ended up in the episode.
sentences.zh: 结果这些镜头一个都没剪进正片里。

sentences.en: And we did like three takes of fake puking off the side of the boat.
sentences.zh: 我们还在船边假装呕吐拍了大概三次。

sentences.en: And that is a sneak peek of Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《办公室女士》的抢先看片段。

sentences.en: I learned something I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我学到了一些我以前不知道的事。

sentences.en: You guys, come hang out with us.
sentences.zh: 大家，快来和我们一起玩吧。

sentences.en: We'll rewatch The Office and, you know, be best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们会重温《办公室》，然后，你知道的，成为最好的朋友。

sentences.en: Subscribe now in Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, or wherever you listen.
sentences.zh: 现在就在Apple Podcasts、Stitcher或任何你收听节目的平台上订阅吧。
